upstream_expectation: the expected output file of the W3C GRDDL Test Cases (2007), which assumes the 2007 input documents
our_expectation: the GRDDL result of both representations, merged as served by www.w3.org today; both representations of td/conneg.html carry <link rel="alternate" href="https://musicbrainz.org/..."> while the 2007 expected output uses http://musicbrainz.org/..., so the result differs from the expected output only by the IRI scheme
rationale: Owner, 2026-10-10, verbatim: "Grddl - postpone for now, i am making enquiries. So just mark it as not a valid test currently." and, correcting the scope: "Grddl should not be postponed, only that test". Marked not a valid test while the owner makes enquiries. The 2007 archive (https://www.w3.org/TR/2007/REC-grddl-tests-20070911/grddl-tests.zip) holds only the local inputs; the 2007 networked inputs were not found. The runner counts the case as local-override and reports a STALE override (a failure) if it starts to pass. Added for this case by the owner, 2026-10-10, verbatim: "730 - do langconneg2 and langconneg3 join h - yes" (the question was whether langconneg2 and langconneg3 join the cases of issue 730 as local overrides, since they differ from the expected graphs only by the http/https scheme). The German representation was vendored on 2026-10-10 (third_party/testing/grddl/PROVENANCE.md); l4grddl selects it per case by language (Harness/GrddlRun.lean).
